summaries: A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD statistical release on new residential construction for August 2022 (released September 20, 2022). Relevant to the task: It provides the seasonally adjusted annual rates (SAAR) for the three index components required for August 2022: total building permits (1,517,000), total housing starts (1,575,000), and total housing completions (1,342,000). This document supplies the initial monthly data point for the required 2022/08–2025/05 window. While it offers specific SAAR figures for this month, subsequent reports in the collection contain revised values for August 2022 which will take precedence under the task's conflict resolution rule.

A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD monthly statistical release for new residential construction in September 2022. It provides the seasonally adjusted annual rates (SAAR) for total building permits, housing starts, and housing completions for September 2022, alongside revised figures for August 2022. Specific values include Permits (Sep: 1,564,000; Aug: 1,542,000), Starts (Sep: 1,439,000; Aug: 1,566,000), and Completions (Sep: 1,427,000; Aug: 1,345,000). This document contributes the necessary inputs to calculate the construction activity index and month-over-month growth for the August–September 2022 period, covering the initial segment of the required 2022/08–2025/05 timeframe. September figures are preliminary and subject to revision by later monthly releases, which would prevail under the task's precedence rule.

A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD monthly statistical release on new residential construction for October 2022 (released November 17, 2022). Relevant to the task: It provides the seasonally adjusted annual rates (SAAR) for total building permits, housing starts, and housing completions required to calculate the construction activity index. The document includes historical monthly SAAR data from August 2022 through October 2022 in its tables, featuring revised figures for August (Permits: 1,542,000; Starts: 1,508,000; Completions: 1,352,000) and September (Permits: 1,564,000; Starts: 1,488,000; Completions: 1,431,000) alongside October 2022 preliminary values (Permits: 1,526,000; Starts: 1,425,000; Completions: 1,339,000). This allows for the calculation of the index and month-over-month growth for the initial segment of the required period. As the most recent report for this timeframe, it provides the authoritative values for August through October 2022 under the precedence rule, though it lacks data for 2023 through May 2025.

A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD monthly statistical release on new residential construction for November 2022. Relevant to the task: It provides the seasonally adjusted annual rates (SAAR) for total building permits, housing starts, and housing completions required for the construction activity index.
